games.name: Pixel Quest [RPG]
games.desc:
After 1x1x1x1 destroyed the Third Dimension, the Robloxians had no other choice than to flee to the 2D world. However, 1x1x1x1 wasn't satisfied and is now set on destroying this pixelated world next. You must explore, find loot, and dodge if you want any chance of survival. Will You Save Our Worlds?

🆕 New Player Experience Update
Learn the world, build your character, and master the early biomes with optional permadeath modes for players seeking a true survival challenge.

⚠️ ALPHA RELEASE ⚠️
Expect Bugs and Changes. I hope you join us on our journey. UPDATES EVERY WEEKEND!

[How to Play]
- Shoot and Dodge Projectiles!
- Find Loot and Level up!
- Complete Quests and Clear Dungeons with friends!
- Decide on power ups that will decide your fate!
- When you are defeated in battle, earn Valor Tokens to spend on Cosmetics and power ups for your next character!

Pixel Quest is a 2D Open World RPG focusing on Bullet Hell combat with Roguelike elements.

games.name: Rusty Plane
games.desc:
Rusty Plane is a chaotic, co-op survival game where everything will go wrong, and that’s the fun of it. You and up to 5 other players must keep a falling-apart plane in the sky by fixing holes, repairing lights and pipes, regaining control, refueling, and re-oxygenating the cabin, all while chaos unfolds around you. Choose from 19 unique classes, each with their own special abilities, and see how long you can survive the madness.

Inspired by My Rusty Submarine
Game is currently in a Public-Beta stage, meaning the game isn't fully finished, so expect small bugs.
This game gets updated almost everyday and bugs are always fixed within a short amount of time. You can report bugs/players or give suggestions using the games feedback system.
If this game causes the end of your friendship, it is not my fault, remember, it's just a game.
